taskDescription: Arrange the steps for correctly eliciting Nikolsky's sign in the proper sequence.
paragraphs: Put on gloves and select an area of apparently normal skin close to, but not on, a lesion.
Place your fingertip or thumb firmly on the selected normal skin.
Apply firm but gentle tangential (sideways, sliding) pressure across the skin surface.
Observe whether the superficial epidermis wrinkles and slides off to leave a moist erosion (positive) or remains intact (negative).
